_source: Facilities, confirmed by Carlos Oct 9 (11:45-12:06; facilities-draft.md v4). Upgrades are instant at fixed prices that double per level (the same for every club, so levels show a club's wealth). Repairs are tied to the level's price: each 1% of condition costs 0.2% of it. Wear 0.5%/week x 0.5-1.5, x1.5 when fan mood is below 30 (stand-in for morale). A facility below 20% at season end has a 50% chance to drop a level (condition reset to 50%). Working level = level x (0.6 + 0.4 x condition). Managers retire at 60-70; a handover costs 5-15% condition. AI clubs repair below 70% and upgrade their lowest facility when they have more than a season of wages in the bank.
